title: Page 172
transc:
Hd Qrs Gen May 29 . 1864
Maj Eckert Di
Snake Elizabeth harrow pony for indigo zebra in view of
this news as the hope opal Pelton are disengage I
respectfully suggest that it be sent by water to land
here or at Hagar in & of Jupiter zodiac shelby
weitzell who so well knows the military situation in adverb
Concurs in this suggestion unity it Can be here in 
female days to waylay oyster depleted by the pandors to
be fought in the mean time walrus Knox good idea
R OBrien


Ft. Monroe May 29 . 1864 
Maj Eckert Di
Bickford and party arrived this morning pedlar have got them
six teams complete and a weaseler to take them direct
to Hagar Pekin have furnished them every thing they wanted
and material to make harrow spoons with what they had
unity teams & wayworners scarce pause they left at sun
down zodiac mack arrived at Hastings at Fanny wedge pekin
has run line from office to Windsor pedlar is now
salmoning his train plum windpipe on a barge says it
will take till Topsy to finish pocketing pekin he will
Commence on Gloucester side at day light in morning has
every thing he wants zebra I will try to go
to Haven whelp unity hope to succeed in my job 
Geo D Sheldon
